ozet: Gerçek olasılıkları (If it rains, we'll …) ve hayalî durumları (If I had more time, I'd …) anlatmayı öğreneceğiz.

bolumler.govde: **If + present simple, will + fiil** → *If it **rains**, we**'ll stay** at home.* / *If I **pass** the test, I**'ll apply** for settlement.*
**If + past simple, would + fiil** → *If I **had** more time, I **would learn** to drive.* / *If I **won** the lottery, I**'d buy** a house.*

satirlar.metin: If it rains on Saturday, we'll go to the cinema instead.
satirlar.tr: Cumartesi yağmur yağarsa onun yerine sinemaya gideriz.

satirlar.metin: If I pass this test, I'll be very happy.
satirlar.tr: Bu sınavı geçersem çok mutlu olurum.

satirlar.metin: If I had more free time, I would join a sports club.
satirlar.tr: Daha çok boş zamanım olsaydı bir spor kulübüne katılırdım.

satirlar.metin: What would you do if you lived near the sea?

bolumler.soru: Görevli “What would you do if you had a free day?” diye soruyor.
bolumler.sonuc: ***If I had a free day, I would go to the seaside with my children because they love the beach.***

bolumler.govde: if'li kısımda will kullanmak: “If it will rain, we stay.” Doğrusu: **If it rains, we'll stay.**

options: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
If it rains, we stay will at home.
If it rained, we'll stay at home.
If it will rain, we'll stay at home.

kontrol.prompt: Boşluğu doldur: “If I ---- more money, I would buy a car.”

options: If I would have time, I go.
If I had time, I will go.
If I had time, I would go to a course.
If I have time, I would go.
